newsitem.title: FINLAND: RETTIG SOLD FINNLINES STAKE - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: RETTIG SOLD FINNLINES STAKE - PAPER.

text.p: Finnish shipping and investment group Rettig has sold its eight percent ownership in Finnish shipping company Finnlines Oy, daily Kauppalehti reported on Wednesday.
"Rettig has during the last couple of weeks sold all its shares in Finnlines," Kauppalehti said.
"Rettig held 1.5 million Finnlines shares, more than eight percent of the company's shares," it added.
The shares were apparently bought by several investors in Finland and overseas, Kauppalehti said, quoting Rettig managing director Tom von Rettig and Finnlines' share register.
"The price was suitable, and we did not have very much in Finnlines after all," Kauppalehti quoted von Rettig as saying.
Rettig sold the shares for more than 150 million markka, and it would book almost a 120 million markka profit on the deals, the paper said.
